Good to know

Frequently asked questions

What grades do you tutor? +

Grades 5 to 7.

Are lessons online? +

Yes — all lessons are online.

How long is a lesson? +

Booked appointments are one hour each.

What subjects do you offer? +

English, Afrikaans, Mathematics, Natural Sciences & Technology, Social Sciences, and Life Skills & Creative Arts.

How much does tutoring cost? +

From R70 to R100 per hour depending on the subject, or choose a subscription (R25/hour, R125/week, R375/month, R975/year).

Can I book on weekends? +

During holiday lessons, Saturdays and Sundays are for booked appointments only. Just send a booking request.

How do subscriptions work? +

Subscriptions give ongoing, discounted access over a week, month or year. Send a booking request and we'll set it up.

How do I book a lesson? +

Use the booking form above — it opens an email to us with your details so we can confirm a time.
